title: chore(deps): update Node to v12
body:
This updates the Node version of the development environment to 12 (LTS). We're having more dependencies that don't support Node 8 so I figured that was the right time to bump the version.

I found the CircleCI Docker Node digest on the [Docker website](https://hub.docker.com/layers/circleci/node/12.14.1/images/sha256-bc28f8653824cc4e28902e73d140011c94dfeda8b1f83393d049daa468f51693).
